remains_events: Create production transparent alpha isometric dark-fantasy RPG prop sprites. Exactly 4 columns and 6 rows, 24 cells, each isolated silhouette fully within its cell with 15px transparent gutters. Camera southeast isometric, detailed realistic painterly materials and readable compact silhouettes. Absolutely no backdrop, no text, no grid, no checkerboard, no background haze. 1024x1536 portrait or higher. Each pair shows the identical object at the identical scale, direction and base position, before and after searching/activation. Row 1: a dead medieval watch soldier lying partly buried in frost with intact belt pouch; SAME soldier with opened pouch and frost brushed off; a dead bundled traveler curled on the ground with small satchel coated in ice; SAME traveler with satchel open and loose snow brushed away. Row 2: a dead miner in heavy wool lying with pick and pack in frost; SAME miner with pack opened; a small haunted stone barrow with sealed low entrance; SAME barrow with stone entrance cracked open and still. Row 3: a small wolf den mound with dark entrance and scattered bones; SAME den abandoned, entrance crumbled; a compact giant spider nest with silk eggs; SAME nest split empty egg sacs and torn web. Row 4: a small cult ritual circle of three stone votives and cloth with dim violet flame; SAME votives dark and ritual exhausted; a compact demonic stone sigil with glowing ember fissures; SAME sigil dark, shattered. Row 5: an abandoned miniature barbarian war camp cache, fur bedroll, two spears and banner; SAME cache plundered with lowered banner; small snowy broken ice fragments; SAME fragments settled. Row 6: a loose closed leather satchel; SAME satchel opened empty; a small shrine incense bowl lit; SAME bowl extinguished. Dead people are adult, fully clothed, restrained environmental storytelling, no gore. Only first six body sprites and ice fragments snowy; other event sprites neutral aged gray-brown stone and earth suitable for multiple biomes. Ground-level bodies are human scale, around twice width of a treasure chest. Preserve genuine alpha transparency outside silhouettes.
